 LIHEAP Applications Being Accepted  
 Posted By: Jennifer Wilkerson 
 November 2, 2026 @ 6:35 am
 Today's Local News 
 Tweet 
 Share 
 Email 
 A program to help Iowans with heating their homes during the winter has started accepting applications as we enter cooler months.  
 The Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program, also called LIHEAP, is accepting applications through April from all households. They are accepted on a first-come, first-served basis. LIHEAP is a federally funded program by the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services. The program aims to assist low income families meet the cost of home heating with a one-time payment. Typically the benefits come as a credit on your utility company’s heating bill. 
 To qualify for LIHEAP, homeowners and renters must meet eligibility requirements within the federal poverty guidelines. To qualify, a family must be at or below 200% of the 2025 federal poverty guidelines, which is $64,300 annual gross income for a family of four. 
 For application information for the LIHEAP program click here. https://www.hacap.org/energy
